sermon.title: Musical Instruments
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer reminds that all are invited into God’s presence by Jesus’ blood, entering with thanksgiving and praise. He then shows the place of instruments: David’s all manner of instruments, four thousand temple musicians, the glory filling the house when instruments and singers were one, prophesying with harps and cymbals, Elisha’s call for a musician, and David’s harp driving off Saul’s evil spirit.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: 1 Chronicles 25:1–3 spoken as “second chronicles 25”; Hebrews 10:19 spoken as “10 9”; Psalm 100:4 spoken as “Psalms 104”; Paul described as having blasphemed the Holy Ghost and committed “both unforgivable sins” and been forgiven; 333 musicians per monthly group estimate.

chunks.section_question: Do we have to wait for Sunday?
chunks.short_answer: No. God is going to move again; you can go into his presence any day. He read the word first, prayed about it, then worshiped and thanked God—and came Sunday with something to give.
chunks.text:

faqs.question: What does praise mean?
faqs.answer: To brag about and boast about Jesus.

faqs.question: Have all kings fallen down before him yet?
faqs.answer: No, he says that hasn’t happened.

faqs.question: What should you do when you sin?
faqs.answer: Run to Jesus and the church, not away.

faqs.question: Who is the gate in God’s spiritual house?
How do we touch the God who dwells in us?
What does prophesy mean?
faqs.answer: To speak by the inspiration of God.

faqs.question: Why does God’s presence come?
faqs.answer: To talk to you, not just give goosebumps.

faqs.question: Does God always move in one music style?
How large was the orchestra at the Vine?
What order did he use in daily devotion?
faqs.answer: Read the word, pray about it, then worship and thank.
